description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

>合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性。
description.en:
The end time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

> Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

description.zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
> 合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据，请确保时间的合法性。
description.en:
The start time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.
> Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid.
